paragraphs: ## ⚠️ Created with Claude. It may contain errors. This whole project (code, tests, CI and docs) was created by Claude, Anthropic's AI assistant, from a conversation with its owner. It has been tested (see below) but not professionally reviewed. Expect bugs, wrong status guesses and rough edges. Check anything important against your real inbox, and please read SECURITY.md before pointing it at a real mailbox.
Job mails come from a few fixed templates, so plain rules are exact, free and testable. Mails that rules can't decide are shown as "Under review" with a check tag instead of guessing.

requirements.text: Sign in with Google works only for addresses added as test users in the owner's Google Cloud project (Google restricts Gmail access until an app passes its verification review).
Use the same email address on all three sites that you sign in to this app with (the Gmail account).
Create a Resend account and an API key; verify a sending domain (the test sender onboarding@resend.dev only delivers to your own Resend account address).
